text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying the bug. You need to find where the problem comes from. Good debugging tools, like a debugger in your code editor, can help you pause the program and check the values of variables. However, you should also use a systematic approach. Instead of changing code randomly, test one part at a time. Logging is another useful method. By adding log messages, you can see what your program is doing step by step. With patience and the right strategy, you can fix most bugs successfully.
